units.zh: 梁書卷第十八 列傳第十二
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 18, Biographies 12
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 18, Biographies 12

units.zh: 張惠紹 馮道根 康絢 昌義之
units.en: Zhang Huishao; Feng Daogen; Kang Xuan; Chang Yizhi
units.literal: Zhang Huishao; Feng Daogen; Kang Xuan; Chang Yizhi

units.zh: 張惠紹，字德繼，義陽人也。
units.en: Zhang Huishao, styled Deji, came from Yiyang.
units.literal: Zhang Huishao, styled Deji, was a native of Yiyang.

units.zh: 少有武幹。
units.en: From youth he showed martial talent.
units.literal: From youth he had martial talent.

units.zh: 齊明帝時爲直閤，後出補竟陵橫桑戍主。
units.en: Under Qi Mingdi he served in the direct attendants; later he was posted as garrison commandant of Hengsang at Jingling.
units.literal: In Qi Mingdi's time he was in the direct attendants; later he went out to supplement garrison commandant of Hengsang at Jingling.

units.zh: 永元初，母喪歸葬於鄉里。
units.en: At the start of Yongyuan his mother died; he went home to bury her.
units.literal: At the start of Yongyuan his mother died; he returned to bury her in his native place.

units.zh: 聞義師起，馳歸高祖，板爲中兵參軍，加寧朔將軍、軍主。
units.en: When he heard the Righteous Army had risen, he rode to Gaozu, who made him central army staff officer with additional pacifying-the-north general and army leader.
units.literal: Hearing the Righteous Army had risen, he galloped to join Gaozu; he was commissioned central army staff officer with additional pacifying-the-north general and army leader.

units.zh: 師次漢口，高祖使惠紹與軍主朱思遠遊遏江中，斷郢、魯二城糧運。
units.en: When the army halted at Hankou, Gaozu sent Huishao and army leader Zhu Siyuan to patrol the river and cut grain supply to Ying and Lu.
units.literal: When the army halted at Hankou, Gaozu had Huishao and army leader Zhu Siyuan patrol the river to cut grain transport to Ying and Lu.

units.zh: 郢城水軍主沈難當帥輕舸數十挑戰，惠紹擊破，斬難當，盡獲其軍器。
units.en: Ying's naval commander Shen Nandang led dozens of light boats to challenge him; Huishao routed him, killed Nandang, and took all his arms.
units.literal: Ying city's naval commander Shen Nandang led several dozen light boats to challenge; Huishao defeated him, beheaded Nandang, and seized all his military gear.

units.zh: 義師次新林、朱雀，惠紹累有戰功。
units.en: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin and Zhuque, Huishao won repeated battle honors.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin and Zhuque, Huishao repeatedly had battle merit.

units.zh: 建康城平，遷輔國將軍、前軍，直閤、左細仗主。
units.en: When Jiankang fell, he was made supporting-the-state general and vanguard army commander, direct attendants and left fine-arms chief.
units.literal: When Jiankang was pacified, he was transferred to supporting-the-state general and vanguard army, direct attendants and left fine-arms chief.

units.zh: 高祖踐阼，封石陽縣侯，邑五百戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, he was enfeoffed marquis of Shiyang with five hundred households.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, he was enfeoffed Marquis of Shiyang with five hundred households.

units.zh: 遷驍騎將軍，直閤、細仗主如故。
units.en: He was transferred to tiger-cavalry general; direct attendants and fine-arms chief as before.
units.literal: Transferred to tiger-cavalry general, direct attendants and fine-arms chief as before.

units.zh: 時東昏餘黨數百人，竊入南北掖門，燒神虎門，害衛尉張弘策。
units.en: Several hundred Donghun holdouts slipped into the south and north side gates, burned Divine Tiger Gate, and killed Ministry of Guard Zhang Hongce.
units.literal: At the time several hundred surviving Donghun partisans secretly entered the south and north side gates, burned Divine Tiger Gate, and killed Ministry of Guard Zhang Hongce.

units.zh: 惠紹馳率所領赴戰，斬首數十級，賊乃散走。
units.en: Huishao galloped in with his men, took several dozen heads, and the rebels broke and fled.
units.literal: Huishao galloped with his command to fight, beheaded several dozen heads, and the rebels scattered and fled.

units.zh: 以功增邑二百戶。
units.en: For merit his fief grew by two hundred households.
units.literal: For merit his fief was increased by two hundred households.

units.zh: 遷太子右衛率。
units.en: He was transferred to crown prince right guard leader.
units.literal: Transferred to crown prince right guard leader.

units.zh: 天監四年，大舉北伐，惠紹與冠軍長史胡辛生、寧朔將軍張豹子攻宿預，執城主馬成龍，送于京師。
units.en: In Tianjian year four the court launched a great northern campaign; Huishao, champion chief of staff Hu Xinsheng, and pacifying-the-north general Zhang Baozi took Suyu, seized the city lord Ma Chenglong, and sent him to the capital.
units.literal: In Tianjian year four a great northern campaign was launched; Huishao with champion chief of staff Hu Xinsheng and pacifying-the-north general Zhang Baozi attacked Suyu, seized city lord Ma Chenglong, and sent him to the capital.

units.zh: 使部將藍懷恭于水南立城爲掎角。
units.en: He sent his deputy Lan Huangong to build a city south of the river as a pincer.
units.literal: He sent subordinate general Lan Huangong to build a city south of the water as a pincer.

units.zh: 俄而魏援大至，敗陷懷恭，惠紹不能守，是夜奔還淮陰，魏復得宿預。
units.en: Soon Wei reinforcements came in force, defeated Huangong and took him; Huishao could not hold the line and fled to Huaiyin that night, and Wei retook Suyu.
units.literal: Before long Wei reinforcements arrived in great numbers, defeated and captured Huangong; Huishao could not hold, that night fled back to Huaiyin, and Wei again took Suyu.

units.zh: 六年，魏軍攻鐘離，詔左衛將軍曹景宗督衆軍爲援，進據邵陽。
units.en: In year six Wei attacked Zhongli; an edict sent left guard general Cao Jingzong to command the relief armies and advance to Shaoyang.
units.literal: In year six Wei forces attacked Zhongli; an edict ordered left guard general Cao Jingzong to supervise the armies as relief, advancing to hold Shaoyang.

units.zh: 惠紹與馮道根、裴邃等攻斷魏連橋，短兵接戰，魏軍大潰。
units.en: Huishao, Feng Daogen, Pei Sui, and others cut Wei's pontoon bridges and fought hand to hand until the Wei army broke completely.
units.literal: Huishao with Feng Daogen, Pei Sui, and others attacked and severed Wei's pontoon bridges, fought at close quarters, and the Wei army was utterly routed.

units.zh: 以功增邑三百戶，還爲左驍騎將軍。
units.en: For merit his fief grew by three hundred households; he returned as left tiger-cavalry general.
units.literal: For merit his fief was increased by three hundred households; he returned as left tiger-cavalry general.

units.zh: 尋出爲持節、都督北兗州諸軍事、冠軍將軍、北兗州刺史。
units.en: Soon he went out bearer of staff, commander of north Yanzhou military affairs, champion general, and north Yanzhou inspector.
units.literal: Soon he went out as bearer of staff, commander of north Yanzhou military affairs, champion general, and north Yanzhou inspector.

units.zh: 魏宿預、淮陽二城內附，惠紹撫納有功，進號智武將軍，益封二百戶。
units.en: When Wei's garrisons at Suyu and Huaiyang came over, Huishao won them over with merit, was raised to wise martial general, and gained two hundred more households.
units.literal: When Wei's Suyu and Huaiyang cities surrendered inward, Huishao comforted and received them with merit, was advanced to wise martial general, and his fief increased by two hundred households.

units.zh: 入爲衛尉卿，遷左衛將軍。
units.en: He entered as Ministry of Guard director, then became left guard general.
units.literal: He entered as Ministry of Guard director and was transferred to left guard general.

units.zh: 出爲持節、都督司州諸軍事、信威將軍、司州刺史、領安陸太守。
units.en: He went out bearer of staff, commander of Si military affairs, faithful prestige general and Si inspector, and also held Anlu prefect.
units.literal: He went out as bearer of staff, commander of Si province military affairs, faithful prestige general, Si inspector, with concurrent Anlu prefect.

units.zh: 在州和理，吏民親愛之。
units.en: In the province he ruled fairly; officials and commoners held him dear.
units.literal: In the province he governed harmoniously; officials and people loved him.

units.zh: 徵還爲左衛將軍，加通直散騎常侍，甲仗百人，直衛殿內。
units.en: Recalled as left guard general with additional undisguised cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, a hundred armed guards, and palace duty within the hall.
units.literal: Summoned back as left guard general with additional undisguised cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, a hundred armed guards, guarding within the palace hall.

units.zh: 十八年，卒，時年六十三。
units.en: In year eighteen he died at sixty-three.
units.literal: In year eighteen he died, aged sixty-three.

units.zh: 詔曰：「張惠紹志略開濟，幹用貞果。
units.en: An edict said, "Zhang Huishao's mind is far-reaching and his hand sure.
units.literal: Edict said: "Zhang Huishao's will and strategy are broad and sustaining; his ability and use are steadfast and resolute.

units.zh: 誠勤義始，績聞累任。
units.en: From the first days of the righteous cause he served faithfully, and merit followed him through every post.
units.literal: Sincerely diligent from righteousness's start, merit heard through successive appointments.

units.zh: 爰居禁旅，盡心朝夕。
units.en: In the forbidden guard he gave his heart morning and evening.
units.literal: Dwelling in the forbidden guard, he gave his heart morning and evening.

units.zh: 奄至殞喪，惻愴于懷。
units.en: Sudden death moves me to grief.
units.literal: Suddenly reaching death and ruin, I am pained in the breast.

units.zh: 宜追寵命，以彰勳烈。
units.en: Let posthumous honors show his martial worth.
units.literal: He should receive posthumous favor to manifest his martial splendor.

units.zh: 可贈護軍將軍，給鼓吹一部，布百匹，蠟二百斤。
units.en: Grant him Protector General, one set of martial music, a hundred bolts of cloth, and two hundred jin of wax.
units.literal: Grant Protector General, give one set of martial music, a hundred bolts of cloth, and two hundred jin of wax.

units.zh: 諡曰忠。」
units.en: Posthumous title: Zhong."
units.literal: Posthumous title: Zhong."

units.zh: 子澄嗣。
units.en: His son Cheng inherited.
units.literal: His son Cheng inherited.

units.zh: 澄初爲直閤將軍，丁父憂，起爲晉熙太守，隨豫州刺史裴邃北伐，累有戰功，與湛僧智、胡紹世、魚弘並當時之驍將。
units.en: Cheng began as direct-attendants general; after his father's mourning he took up Jinxi prefect and followed Yu inspector Pei Sui north, winning repeated honors alongside Zhan Sengzhi, Hu Shaoshi, and Yu Hong among the age's fiercest commanders.
units.literal: Cheng at first was direct-attendants general; on his father's mourning he was recalled as Jinxi prefect, followed Yu inspector Pei Sui on the northern campaign, repeatedly had battle merit, and with Zhan Sengzhi, Hu Shaoshi, and Yu Hong was among the fierce generals of the age.

units.zh: 歷官衛尉卿、太子左衛率。
units.en: He rose to Ministry of Guard director and crown prince left guard leader.
units.literal: Through office he reached Ministry of Guard director and crown prince left guard leader.

units.zh: 卒官，諡曰愍。
units.en: He died in office; posthumous title: Min.
units.literal: He died in office; posthumous title: Min.

units.zh: 馮道根，字巨基，廣平酂人也。
units.en: Feng Daogen, styled Juji, came from Zan in Guangping.
units.literal: Feng Daogen, styled Juji, was a native of Zan in Guangping.

units.zh: 少失父，家貧，傭賃以養母。
units.en: He lost his father young; the household was poor, and he hired himself out to feed his mother.
units.literal: Young, he lost his father; the family was poor; he hired out his labor to support his mother.

units.zh: 行得甘肥，不敢先食，必遽還以進母。
units.en: On the road he might find rich food, but he never tasted it first—he always hurried home to set it before his mother.
units.literal: When traveling he got sweet and rich food, he dared not eat first, always hurried back to present it to his mother.

units.zh: 年十三，以孝聞於鄉里。
units.en: At thirteen his filial conduct was known through the village.
units.literal: At age thirteen he was famed in the village for filial conduct.

units.zh: 郡召爲主簿，辭不就。
units.en: The commandery made him chief clerk; he refused.
units.literal: The commandery summoned him as chief clerk; he declined and did not accept.

units.zh: 年十六，鄉人蔡道斑爲湖陽戍主，道斑攻蠻錫城，反爲蠻所困，道根救之。
units.en: At sixteen his neighbor Cai Daoban held Huyang garrison; Daoban attacked the Man at Xicheng, was surrounded, and Daogen saved him.
units.literal: At age sixteen his fellow villager Cai Daoban was Huyang garrison commandant; Daoban attacked Man at Xicheng, in turn was trapped by the Man, and Daogen rescued him.

units.zh: 匹馬轉戰，殺傷甚多，道斑以免，由是知名。
units.en: Alone on horseback he fought round and round, killing many; Daoban was spared, and Daogen's name spread.
units.literal: Alone on horseback he wheeled through battle; killing and wounding were many; Daoban escaped harm, and thus Daogen became known.

units.zh: 齊建武末，魏主托跋宏寇沒南陽等五郡，明帝遣太尉陳顯達率衆復爭之。
units.en: Late in Qi Jianwu, Wei's Tuoba Hong overran the five commanderies including Nanyang; Mingdi sent Grand Marshal Chen Xianda to win them back.
units.literal: Late in Qi Jianwu, Wei ruler Tuoba Hong raided and captured the five commanderies including Nanyang; Mingdi sent Grand Marshal Chen Xianda with a host to recover them.

units.zh: 師入汮均口，道根與鄉里人士以牛酒候軍，因說顯達曰：「汋水迅急，難進易退。
units.en: The army entered Fen and Jun mouth; Daogen and his neighbors brought oxen and wine to the camp and told Xianda, "The Chuo runs fast—hard to advance, easy to retreat.
units.literal: The army entered at Fen and Jun mouth; Daogen with fellow villagers brought oxen and wine to greet the army and said to Xianda: "The Chuo water runs swift—hard to advance, easy to retreat.

units.zh: 魏若守隘，則首尾俱急。
units.en: If Wei holds the narrows, you are caught at both ends.
units.literal: If Wei holds the pass, then head and tail are both pressed.

units.zh: 不如悉棄船艦於酂城，方道步進，建營相次，鼓行而前。
units.en: Better leave the boats at Zan, march by land, set camps in line, and advance to the drum.
units.literal: Better to abandon all boats at Zan city, march by land roads, build camps in succession, and drum forward.

units.zh: 如是，則立破之矣。」
units.en: Then you will break them at once."
units.literal: Thus they can be broken at once."

units.zh: 顯達不聽，道根猶以私屬從軍。
units.en: Xianda would not hear him; Daogen still followed with his own men.
units.literal: Xianda would not listen; Daogen still followed the army with his private followers.

units.zh: 及顯達敗，軍人夜走，多不知山路；
units.en: When Xianda was beaten, the army fled by night, many lost on the mountain paths;
units.literal: When Xianda was defeated, at night the soldiers fled, many not knowing the mountain roads;

units.zh: 道根每及險要，輒停馬指示之，衆賴以全。
units.en: at every pass Daogen stopped his horse and showed the way, and many owed their lives to him.
units.literal: at every dangerous point Daogen halted his horse and pointed the way; the multitude relied on him and were preserved whole.

units.zh: 尋爲汮口戍副。
units.en: Soon he was made deputy at Fen mouth garrison.
units.literal: Soon he was made Fen mouth garrison deputy.

units.zh: 永元中，以母喪還家。
units.en: In Yongyuan his mother died and he went home.
units.literal: In Yongyuan his mother died and he returned home.

units.zh: 聞高祖起義師，乃謂所親曰：「金革奪禮，古人不避，揚名後世，豈非孝乎？
units.en: When he heard Gaozu had raised the Righteous Army, he told those close to him, "War suspends mourning—men of old did not shrink from it; to leave a name behind—is that not filial?
units.literal: Hearing Gaozu had raised the Righteous Army, he said to intimates: "Metal and war seize mourning ritual—men of old did not avoid it; to raise a name for later ages—is that not filial?

units.zh: 時不可失，吾其行矣。」
units.en: The moment will not wait; I am going."
units.literal: The time cannot be lost; I shall go."

units.zh: 率鄉人子弟勝兵者，悉歸高祖。
units.en: He led able men from the village and his kin and went to Gaozu.
units.literal: Leading fellow villagers and younger kinsmen fit for arms, all returned to Gaozu.

units.zh: 時有蔡道福爲將從軍，高祖使道根副之，皆隸於王茂。
units.en: Cai Daofu was then a general in the host; Gaozu set Daogen under him, both under Wang Mao.
units.literal: At the time Cai Daofu was a general in the army; Gaozu had Daogen assist him, both subordinate to Wang Mao.

units.zh: 茂伐沔，攻郢城，克加湖，道根常爲前鋒陷陳。
units.en: Mao struck Mian, besieged Ying, and took Jiahu; Daogen was often first through the line.
units.literal: Mao attacked Mian, assaulted Ying city, and took Jiahu; Daogen was often vanguard breaking formations.

units.zh: 會道福卒於軍，高祖令道根并領其衆。
units.en: When Daofu died in camp, Gaozu gave Daogen his men as well.
units.literal: When Daofu died in the army, Gaozu ordered Daogen also to lead his troops.

units.zh: 大軍次新林，隨王茂於朱雀航大戰，斬獲尤多。
units.en: When the host reached Xinlin, he followed Wang Mao at Zhuque ford in a great battle and took heads and prisoners in unusual numbers.
units.literal: The great army reached Xinlin; following Wang Mao at Zhuque ford he fought a great battle, and beheadings and captures were especially many.

units.zh: 高祖卽位，以爲驍騎將軍，封增城縣男，邑二百戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, he made Daogen tiger-cavalry general and baron of Zengcheng with two hundred households.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Daogen was made tiger-cavalry general and enfeoffed Baron of Zengcheng with two hundred households.

units.zh: 領文德帥，遷遊擊將軍。
units.en: He led Wendé commanders, then became raiding general.
units.literal: He led Wendé commanders and was transferred to raiding general.

units.zh: 是歲，江州刺史陳伯之反，道根隨王茂討平之。
units.en: That year Jiangzhou inspector Chen Bozhi rebelled; Daogen followed Wang Mao and put him down.
units.literal: That year Jiangzhou inspector Chen Bozhi rebelled; Daogen followed Wang Mao to pacify him.

units.zh: 天監二年，爲寧朔將軍、南梁太守，領阜陵城戍。
units.en: In Tianjian year two he was pacifying-the-north general and Nan Liang prefect, holding Fuling garrison.
units.literal: In Tianjian year two he was made pacifying-the-north general and Nan Liang prefect, leading Fuling city garrison.

units.zh: 初到阜陵，脩城隍，遠斥候，有如敵將至者，衆頗笑之。
units.en: On reaching Fuling he repaired walls and moats and set far scouts as if a great enemy were near; his men mostly laughed.
units.literal: When he first reached Fuling he repaired walls and moats and posted distant scouts as if a great enemy were about to come; the host mostly laughed.

units.zh: 道根曰：「怯防勇戰，此之謂也。」
units.en: Daogen said, "Guard like a coward, fight like a brave man—that is the saying."
units.literal: Daogen said: "Guard timidly, fight bravely—that is the saying."

units.zh: 脩城未畢，會魏將党法宗、傅豎眼率衆二萬，奄至城下。
units.en: Before the walls were done, Wei generals Dang Fazong and Fu Shuyan came with twenty thousand men and were suddenly at the gates.
units.literal: Before the walls were finished, Wei generals Dang Fazong and Fu Shuyan led twenty thousand men and suddenly reached the city.

units.zh: 道根塹壘未固，城中衆少，皆失色。
units.en: Trenches and ramparts were unfinished; the city held few men; faces went white.
units.literal: Daogen's trenches and ramparts were not yet solid; there were few men in the city; all turned pale.

units.zh: 道根命廣開門，緩服登城，選精銳二百人，出與魏軍戰，敗之。
units.en: Daogen had the gates thrown wide, climbed the wall in plain dress, chose two hundred elite, went out, and beat the Wei force.
units.literal: Daogen ordered the gates opened wide, dressed plainly, climbed the wall, chose two hundred elite men, went out to fight the Wei army, and defeated them.

units.zh: 魏人見意閑，且戰又不利，因退走。
units.en: Seeing his ease and their own ill luck, the Wei men drew off.
units.literal: The Wei men saw his bearing at ease and that battle was also unfavorable, so they withdrew.

units.zh: 是時魏分兵於大小峴、東桑等，連城相持。
units.en: Wei then split forces at Great and Small Xian, Dongsang, and elsewhere, chaining towns in a standoff.
units.literal: Then Wei divided troops at Great and Small Xian, Dongsang, and other places, linking cities in stalemate.

units.zh: 魏將高祖珍以三千騎軍其間，道根率百騎橫擊破之，獲其鼓角軍儀。
units.en: Wei general Gao Zuzhen moved three thousand horse between them; Daogen led a hundred horsemen in a flanking strike, routed him, and took drums, horns, and standards.
units.literal: Wei general Gao Zuzhen ranged three thousand horse among them; Daogen led a hundred horse in a cross strike, broke them, and seized their drums, horns, and military banners.

units.zh: 於是糧運旣絕，諸軍乃退。
units.en: Grain supply was cut, and the Wei armies pulled back.
units.literal: Thereupon grain transport was cut off and the armies withdrew.

units.zh: 遷道根輔國將軍。
units.en: Daogen was made supporting-the-state general.
units.literal: Daogen was transferred to supporting-the-state general.

units.zh: 豫州刺史韋叡圍合肥，克之。
units.en: Yu inspector Wei Rui besieged Hefei and captured it.
units.literal: Yu inspector Wei Rui besieged Hefei and took it.

units.zh: 道根與諸軍同進，所在有功。
units.en: Daogen marched with the host and won merit wherever he fought.
units.literal: Daogen advanced with the armies together; wherever he went he had merit.

units.zh: 六年，魏攻鐘離，高祖復詔叡救之，道根率衆三千爲叡前驅。
units.en: In year six Wei attacked Zhongli; Gaozu again ordered Wei Rui to the rescue; Daogen led three thousand as his vanguard.
units.literal: In year six Wei attacked Zhongli; Gaozu again issued an edict to Rui to rescue; Daogen led three thousand men as Rui's vanguard.

units.zh: 至徐州，建計據邵陽洲，築壘掘塹，以逼魏城。
units.en: At Xuzhou he planned to hold Shaoyang islet, raise ramparts, and dig moats against the Wei city.
units.literal: Reaching Xuzhou, he devised a plan to hold Shaoyang islet, build ramparts, and dig moats to press the Wei city.

units.zh: 道根能走馬步地，計馬足以賦功，城隍立辦。
units.en: Daogen could ride hard and pace a site, allotting horse labor so work matched need; walls and moats rose at once.
units.literal: Daogen could run on horseback and pace the ground, calculating horse labor enough to assign work; walls and moats were set up at once.

units.zh: 及淮水長，道根乘戰艦，攻斷魏連橋數百丈，魏軍敗績。
units.en: When the Huai swelled, he took war boats, cut hundreds of zhang of Wei pontoon bridge, and the Wei army was routed.
units.literal: When the Huai rose, Daogen boarded warships, attacked and severed several hundred zhang of Wei pontoon bridges, and the Wei army suffered great defeat.

units.zh: 益封三百戶，進爵爲伯。
units.en: His fief grew by three hundred households and he was raised to earl.
units.literal: His fief increased by three hundred households and he was advanced to earl.

units.zh: 還遷雲騎將軍、領直閤將軍，改封豫寧縣，戶邑如前。
units.en: Recalled, he became cloud-cavalry general and led the direct attendants; his fief moved to Yuning county, households unchanged.
units.literal: On return he was transferred to cloud-cavalry general and leading direct-attendants general; his enfeoffment was changed to Yuning county, households as before.

units.zh: 累遷中權中司馬、右遊擊將軍、武旅將軍、歷陽太守。
units.en: He rose through central staff marshal, right raiding general, martial guard general, and Liyang prefect.
units.literal: He was repeatedly transferred through central staff marshal, right raiding general, martial guard general, and Liyang prefect.

units.zh: 八年，遷貞毅將軍、假節、督豫州諸軍事、豫州刺史、領汝陰太守。
units.en: In year eight he was steadfast resolve general with acting credentials, commander of Yu military affairs, Yu inspector, and also Ruyin prefect.
units.literal: In year eight he was transferred to steadfast resolve general, acting credentials, commander of Yu military affairs, Yu inspector, with concurrent Ruyin prefect.

units.zh: 爲政清簡，境內安定。
units.en: He ruled plainly and kept the borders quiet.
units.literal: His governance was pure and simple; within the borders was peaceful.

units.zh: 十一年，徵爲太子右衛率。
units.en: In year eleven he was recalled as crown prince right guard leader.
units.literal: In year eleven he was summoned as crown prince right guard leader.

units.zh: 十三年，出爲信武將軍、宣惠司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: In year thirteen he went out faithful martial general, proclaiming-grace staff officer, and prefect of Xin and Yongning.
units.literal: In year thirteen he went out as faithful martial general, proclaiming-grace staff officer, and prefect of Xin and Yongning commanderies.

units.zh: 十四年，徵爲員外散騎常侍、右遊擊將軍，領朱衣直閤。
units.en: In year fourteen he was recalled as outer cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and right raiding general, leading the crimson-robed direct attendants.
units.literal: In year fourteen he was summoned as outer cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and right raiding general, leading crimson-robed direct attendants.

units.zh: 十五年，爲右衛將軍。
units.en: In year fifteen he was made right guard general.
units.literal: In year fifteen he was made right guard general.

units.zh: 道根性謹厚，木訥少言，爲將能檢禦部曲，所過村陌，將士不敢虜掠。
units.en: Daogen was careful and plain, slow of speech; as a commander he held his men tight, and on village roads they dared not loot.
units.literal: Daogen's nature was careful and thick, wooden and reticent with few words; as a general he could restrain his squads; wherever he passed village lanes his soldiers dared not plunder.

units.zh: 每所征伐，終不言功，諸將讙嘩爭競，道根默然而已。
units.en: He never spoke of merit on campaign; while other generals shouted over credit, Daogen stayed mute.
units.literal: In every campaign he never spoke of merit; when generals clamored and competed for credit, Daogen was silent—that was all.

units.zh: 其部曲或怨非之，道根喻曰：「明主自鑒功之多少，吾將何事。」
units.en: Some in his command grumbled; Daogen told them, "The bright lord sees merit for himself—what is there for me to say?"
units.literal: His squads sometimes resented and blamed him; Daogen explained: "The bright lord himself discerns how much merit there is—what affair is it of mine?"

units.zh: 高祖嘗指道根示尚書令沈約曰：「此人口不論勳。」
units.en: Gaozu once pointed Daogen out to Director Shen Yue and said, "This one never speaks of merit."
units.literal: Gaozu once pointed at Daogen to show Director of the Imperial Secretariat Shen Yue: "This man's mouth does not discuss merit."

units.zh: 約曰：「此陛下之大樹將軍也。」
units.en: Yue said, "This is Your Majesty's great-tree general."
units.literal: Yue said: "This is Your Majesty's great-tree general."

units.zh: 處州郡，和理清靜，爲部下所懷。
units.en: In province and commandery he ruled fairly and quietly, and those under him held him close.
units.literal: Dwelling in provinces and commanderies, he governed harmoniously and quietly and was cherished by those below.

units.zh: 在朝廷，雖貴顯而性儉約，所居宅不營牆屋，無器服侍衛，入室則蕭然如素士之貧賤者。
units.en: At court he was great in rank yet spare in habit; he built no compound walls, kept no guards, and his rooms looked as bare as any poor scholar's.
units.literal: At court, though noble and eminent, his nature was frugal and spare; the house where he lived had no enclosing walls raised, no attendants or guards, and when one entered it was bleak as a plain scholar's poverty.

units.zh: 當時服其清退，高祖亦雅重之。
units.en: Men praised his modesty; Gaozu prized him as well.
units.literal: At the time people admired his restraint; Gaozu also held him in high esteem.

units.zh: 微時不學，旣貴，粗讀書，自謂少文，常慕周勃之器重。
units.en: He had never studied in youth; after rank came to him he read a little, called himself unlettered, and often spoke of Zhou Bo's solid bearing.
units.literal: In humble days he had not studied; once ennobled he read books in rough fashion, calling himself short on letters and often admiring Zhou Bo's weightiness.

units.zh: 十六年，復假節、都督豫州諸軍事、信武將軍、豫州刺史。
units.en: In year sixteen he again received brevet staff, command of Yuzhou forces, the title Trustworthy Martial General, and the inspector's seal.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was again given brevet staff and made Area Commander of Yuzhou military affairs, Trustworthy Martial General, and Yuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 將行，高祖引朝臣宴別道根於武德殿，召工視道根，使圖其形像。
units.en: On the eve of his departure Gaozu feasted him at Wude Hall, called in painters to study his face, and ordered his portrait made.
units.literal: Before he set out, Gaozu led the court in a farewell feast for Daogen at Wude Hall, summoned artisans to observe him, and had them paint his likeness.

units.zh: 道根踧踖謝曰：「臣所可報國家，惟餘一死；
units.en: Daogen flushed and refused: "All I can still offer the realm is whatever life remains;
units.literal: Daogen, abashed, declined: "What your servant can repay the state is only a life left over;

units.zh: 但天下太平，臣恨無可死之地。」
units.en: yet the world is at peace, and I mourn that there is nowhere left to spend it."
units.literal: but the realm is at peace, and your servant grieves that there is no place worthy to die."

units.zh: 豫部重得道根，人皆喜悅。
units.en: Yuzhou had him again and the people rejoiced.
units.literal: Yuzhou welcomed Daogen back and all rejoiced.

units.zh: 高祖每稱曰：「馮道根所在，能使朝廷不復憶有一州。」
units.en: Gaozu would say, "With Feng Daogen in place, the throne forgets it still holds a province."
units.literal: Gaozu often said: "Wherever Feng Daogen is, the court need not remember there is still a province."

units.zh: 居州少時，遇疾，自表乞還朝，徵爲散騎常侍、左軍將軍。
units.en: After only a short time in the province, Daogen fell ill and submitted a memorial requesting to return to court; he was summoned as Regular Attendant and Left Army General.
units.literal: After only a short time in the province, Daogen fell ill and submitted a memorial requesting to return to court; he was summoned as Regular Attendant and Left Army General.

units.zh: 旣至疾甚，中使累加存問。
units.en: After he arrived, his illness became severe, and palace envoys repeatedly came to ask after him.
units.literal: After he arrived, his illness became severe, and palace envoys repeatedly came to ask after him.

units.zh: 普通元年正月，卒，時年五十八。
units.en: In the first month of Putong 1, he died, aged fifty-eight.
units.literal: In the first month of Putong 1, he died, aged fifty-eight.

units.zh: 是日輿駕春祠二廟，旣出宮，有司以聞。
units.en: That day the imperial carriage was setting out for the spring sacrifices at the two ancestral temples; after it had left the palace, the responsible offices reported the news.
units.literal: That day the imperial carriage was setting out for the spring sacrifices at the two ancestral temples; after it had left the palace, the responsible offices reported the news.

units.zh: 高祖問中書舍人朱异曰：「吉凶同日，今行乎？」
units.en: Gaozu asked Zhu Yi, Secretariat Drafter, "Auspicious and inauspicious events fall on the same day. Should we go now?"
units.literal: Gaozu asked Zhu Yi, Secretariat Drafter, "Auspicious and inauspicious events fall on the same day. Should we go now?"

units.zh: 异對曰：「昔柳莊寢疾，衛獻公當祭，請於尸曰：『有臣柳莊，非寡人之臣，是社稷之臣也，聞其死，請往。』
units.en: Zhu Yi replied, "Formerly, when Liu Zhuang lay ill and Duke Xian of Wei was about to sacrifice, the duke asked the spirit impersonator, saying, 'There is my minister Liu Zhuang; he is not merely my minister, but a minister of the altars of soil and grain. Hearing that he has died, I ask to go.'
units.literal: Zhu Yi replied, "Formerly, when Liu Zhuang lay ill and Duke Xian of Wei was about to sacrifice, the duke asked the spirit impersonator, saying, 'There is my minister Liu Zhuang; he is not merely my minister, but a minister of the altars of soil and grain. Hearing that he has died, I ask to go.'

units.zh: 不釋祭服而往，遂以襚之。
units.en: Without removing his sacrificial robes, the duke went and then bestowed burial garments on him.
units.literal: Without removing his sacrificial robes, the duke went and then bestowed burial garments on him.

units.zh: 道根雖未爲社稷之臣，亦有勞王室，臨之禮也。」
units.en: Though Daogen was not yet a minister of the altars of soil and grain, he too had labored for the royal house; visiting him is proper ritual."
units.literal: Though Daogen was not yet a minister of the altars of soil and grain, he too had labored for the royal house; visiting him is proper ritual."

units.zh: 高祖卽幸其宅，哭之甚慟。
units.en: Gaozu immediately went to his residence and wept with deep grief.
units.literal: Gaozu immediately went to his residence and wept with deep grief.

units.zh: 詔曰：「豫寧縣開國伯、新除散騎常侍、領左軍將軍馮道根，奉上能忠，有功不伐，撫人留愛，守邊難犯，祭遵、馮異、郭伋、李牧，不能過也。
units.en: The edict said, "Feng Daogen, founding Count of Yuning county, newly appointed Regular Attendant and acting Left Army General, served his sovereign with loyalty, had merit without boasting, governed the people and left affection behind, and defended the frontier so that it was hard to violate; Ji Zun, Feng Yi, Guo Ji, and Li Mu could not surpass him.
units.literal: The edict said, "Feng Daogen, founding Count of Yuning county, newly appointed Regular Attendant and acting Left Army General, served his sovereign with loyalty, had merit without boasting, governed the people and left affection behind, and defended the frontier so that it was hard to violate; Ji Zun, Feng Yi, Guo Ji, and Li Mu could not surpass him.

units.zh: 奄致殞喪，惻愴於懷。
units.en: That he has suddenly come to death and loss fills Our heart with sorrow.
units.literal: That he has suddenly come to death and loss fills Our heart with sorrow.

units.zh: 可贈信威將軍、左衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: He may be posthumously granted the offices of General Who Inspires Trusting Awe and Left Guard General, and given one corps of drummers and pipers.
units.literal: He may be posthumously granted the offices of General Who Inspires Trusting Awe and Left Guard General, and given one corps of drummers and pipers.

units.zh: 賻錢十萬，布百匹。
units.en: Grant funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.
units.literal: Grant funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.

units.zh: 諡曰威。」
units.en: His posthumous title shall be Wei."
units.literal: His posthumous title shall be Wei."

units.zh: 子懷嗣。
units.en: His son Huai inherited.
units.literal: His son Huai inherited.

units.zh: 康絢字長明，華山藍田人也。
units.en: Kang Xuan, styled Changming, came from Lantian on Hua Mountain.
units.literal: Kang Xuan, styled Changming, was a native of Lantian in Hua Mountain.

units.zh: 其先出自康居。
units.en: His line sprang from Kangju.
units.literal: His ancestors came out of Kangju.

units.zh: 初，漢置都護，盡臣西域。
units.en: In early Han a Protector-General was set and the western lands were brought to heel.
units.literal: At first Han set a Protector-General and made all the Western Regions submit.

units.zh: 康居亦遣侍子待詔於河西，因留爲黔首，其後卽以康爲姓。
units.en: Kangju also sent a royal hostage to wait on the court at Hexi and stayed as settlers; later they took Kang for their name.
units.literal: Kangju too sent a hostage prince to wait on the edicts at Hexi and so remained as common folk; afterward they took Kang as surname.

units.zh: 晉時隴右亂，康氏遷于藍田。
units.en: Under Jin, Longyou fell into chaos and the Kang moved to Lantian.
units.literal: In Jin times turmoil rose in Longyou and the Kang clan moved to Lantian.

units.zh: 絢曾祖因爲苻堅太子詹事，生穆，穆爲姚萇河南尹。
units.en: His great-grandfather served Fu Jian's heir as household steward and begat Mu, who became Yao Chang's Henan intendant.
units.literal: Xuan's great-grandfather served as Fu Jian's crown-prince household steward and begat Mu; Mu became Yao Chang's Henan Intendant.

units.zh: 宋永初中，穆舉鄉族三千餘家，入襄陽之峴南。
units.en: In Song's early Yongchu years Mu led more than three thousand township families into the south of Mount Xian at Xiangyang.
units.literal: In the early Yongchu era of Song, Mu led more than three thousand families of the township into the south of Mount Xian at Xiangyang.

units.zh: 宋爲置華山郡藍田縣，寄居于襄陽，以穆爲秦、梁二州刺史。
units.en: Song lodged them as Lantian county in Hua Mountain commandery at Xiangyang and named Mu governor of Qin and Liang.
units.literal: Song set up Hua Mountain commandery's Lantian county as a lodging in Xiangyang and made Mu Governor of Qin and Liang provinces.

units.zh: 未拜，卒。
units.en: He died before he could take the post.
units.literal: Before he took the appointment he died.

units.zh: 絢世父元隆，父元撫，並爲流人所推，相繼爲華山太守。
units.en: His uncle Yuanlong and father Yuanfu, leaders among the exiles, each in turn held Hua Mountain.
units.literal: Xuan's paternal uncle Yuanlong and father Yuanfu were both pushed forward by the displaced and in turn became Hua Mountain Administrator.

units.zh: 絢少俶儻有志氣。
units.en: From youth Xuan was bold and full of purpose.
units.literal: Xuan from youth was bold and high-spirited.

units.zh: 齊文帝爲雍州刺史，所辟皆取名家，絢特以才力召爲西曹書佐。
units.en: When Qi Wendi governed Yongzhou he took only men of great families; Xuan was specially summoned for his ability as Western Bureau Secretary.
units.literal: When Qi Wendi was Yongzhou Inspector his recruits were all drawn from great houses; Xuan was specially summoned for talent as Western Bureau Secretary.

units.zh: 永明三年，除奉朝請。
units.en: In Yongming year three he became court attendant.
units.literal: In the third year of Yongming he was made Court Attendant.

units.zh: 文帝在東宮，以舊恩引爲直後，以母憂去職。
units.en: Wendi in the Eastern Palace recalled him as guard attendant; he left for his mother's mourning.
units.literal: When Wendi was in the Eastern Palace he drew him in for old favor as Palace Guard Attendant; he left office on his mother's mourning.

units.zh: 服闋，除振威將軍、華山太守。
units.en: After mourning he became Quelling Might General and Hua Mountain administrator.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was made Quelling Might General and Hua Mountain Administrator.

units.zh: 推誠撫循，荒餘悅服。
units.en: He ruled the ravaged district with open hand and honest heart until it was glad to obey.
units.literal: He won the wasted land with sincerity and gentle rule.

units.zh: 遷前軍將軍，復爲華山太守。
units.en: He rose to vanguard general and again held Hua Mountain.
units.literal: He was transferred to Vanguard General and again made Hua Mountain Administrator.

units.zh: 永元元年，義兵起，絢舉郡以應高祖，身率敢勇三千人，私馬二百五十匹以從。
units.en: In Yongyuan year one the righteous army rose; Xuan raised his commandery for Gaozu and led three thousand bold men and two hundred fifty horses of his own.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan the righteous army rose; Xuan raised the commandery to answer Gaozu, himself leading three thousand daredevils and two hundred fifty private horses to follow.

units.zh: 除西中郎南康王中兵參軍，加輔國將軍。
units.en: He was made staff officer to the Prince of Nankang and given the added rank Assists-the-State General.
units.literal: He was made Central Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Nankang of the Western Corps, with the added title Assists-the-State General.

units.zh: 義師方圍張沖於郢城，曠日持久，東昏將吳子陽壁于加湖，軍鋒甚盛，絢隨王茂力攻屠之。
units.en: While the loyal army pinned Zhang Chong at Yingcheng, Donghun's Wu Ziyang held Jiahu with a fierce host; Xuan rode with Wang Mao and broke them in the slaughter.
units.literal: As the righteous host besieged Zhang Chong at Yingcheng day after day without end, Donghun's general Wu Ziyang walled at Jiahu with a very sharp army; Xuan followed Wang Mao and stormed him to slaughter.

units.zh: 自是常領遊兵，有急應赴，斬獲居多。
units.en: After that he usually led flying columns, answering every alarm, and his kills and captures piled high.
units.literal: From then on he often led mobile troops, rushing wherever need pressed, and his beheadings and captures were many.

units.zh: 天監元年，封南安縣男，邑三百戶。
units.en: In Tianjian year one he was made Baron of Nan'an, three hundred households.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianjian he was enfeoffed as Baron of Nan'an with a fief of three hundred households.

units.zh: 除輔國將軍、竟陵太守。
units.en: He became assists-the-state general and Jingling administrator.
units.literal: He was made Assists-the-State General and Administrator of Jingling.

units.zh: 魏圍梁州，刺史王珍國使請救，絢以郡兵赴之，魏軍退。
units.en: Wei besieged Liangzhou; Wang Zhenguo called for aid; Xuan marched with the commandery levy and Wei drew off.
units.literal: When Wei besieged Liang province, Inspector Wang Zhenguo sent asking rescue; Xuan led the commandery troops to him and the Wei army withdrew.

units.zh: 七年，司州三關爲魏所逼，詔假絢節、武旅將軍，率衆赴援。
units.en: In year seven Wei pressed Si's three passes; Xuan received brevet staff and Martial Host General and marched to relieve them.
units.literal: In the seventh year the three passes of Si province were pressed by Wei; an edict gave Xuan brevet staff and Martial Host General to lead troops to relieve them.

units.zh: 九年，遷假節、督北兗州緣淮諸軍事、振遠將軍、北兗州刺史。
units.en: In year nine he took brevet staff, command along the Huai frontier, Quelling Distance General, and North Yanzhou.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to brevet staff, Area Commander of North Yanzhou forces along the Huai, Quelling Distance General, and North Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 及朐山亡徒以城降魏，絢馳遣司馬霍奉伯分軍據嶮。
units.en: When Mount Qu's outlaws handed their walls to Wei, Xuan sent Major Huo Fengbo ahead to seize the heights.
units.literal: When fugitives at Mount Qu surrendered the city to Wei, Xuan galloped and sent his Major Huo Fengbo to divide the army and hold the passes.

units.zh: 魏軍至，不得越朐城。
units.en: Wei came and could not pass Qu city.
units.literal: The Wei army came but could not cross beyond Qu city.

units.zh: 明年，青州刺史張稷爲土人徐道角所殺，絢又遣司馬茅榮伯討平之。
units.en: Next year Zhang Ji of Qingzhou was killed by Xu Daojiao; Xuan sent Major Mao Rongbo to crush the revolt.
units.literal: The next year Qing province Inspector Zhang Ji was killed by the local man Xu Daojiao; Xuan again sent Major Mao Rongbo to suppress and settle it.

units.zh: 徵驃騎臨川王司馬，加左驍騎將軍，尋轉朱衣直閤。
units.en: He was summoned as Chief of Staff to the General of Agile Cavalry, the Prince of Linchuan, given the added rank Left Valiant Cavalry General, then soon transferred to Vermilion-Robe Palace Attendant.
units.literal: He was summoned as Chief of Staff to the General of Agile Cavalry, the Prince of Linchuan, given the added rank Left Valiant Cavalry General, and soon transferred to Vermilion-Robe Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 十三年，遷太子右衛率，甲仗百人，與領軍蕭景直殿內。
units.en: In year thirteen he became Crown Prince Right Guard Leader with a hundred armored men, on palace duty with Xiao Jing.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was made Crown Prince Right Guard Leader with a hundred men in armor, dwelling in the palace with Army Leader Xiao Jing.

units.zh: 絢身長八尺，容貌絕倫，雖居顯官，猶習武藝。
units.en: Xuan stood eight feet, unmatched in bearing, and still drilled in arms though he wore high rank.
units.literal: Xuan stood eight feet tall with peerless looks; though he held high office he still practiced martial arts.

units.zh: 高祖幸德陽殿戲馬，敕絢馬射，撫弦貫的，觀者悅之。
units.en: Gaozu watched horse games at Deyang Hall and bade Xuan shoot from the saddle; his arrow struck true and the court was delighted.
units.literal: When Gaozu visited Deyang Hall for horse games he ordered Xuan to shoot from horseback; he drew the bow and pierced the mark, and the watchers were pleased.

units.zh: 其日，上使畫工圖絢形，遣中使持以問絢曰：「卿識此圖不？」
units.en: That day he had artists paint Xuan and sent an emissary with the scroll: "Do you know this picture?"
units.literal: That day the emperor had a painter draft Xuan's form and sent a palace emissary holding it to ask, "Do you know this picture?"

units.zh: 其見親如此。
units.en: So close was he to the throne.
units.literal: Such was the degree of his favor.

units.zh: 時魏降人王足陳計，求堰淮水以灌壽陽。
units.en: Then Wang Zu, a man who had come over from Wei, urged damming the Huai to drown Shouyang.
units.literal: At the time the Wei surrenderer Wang Zu offered a plan to dam the Huai and flood Shouyang.

units.zh: 足引北方童謠曰：「荊山爲上格，浮山爲下格，潼沱爲激溝，併灌鉅野澤。」
units.en: Zu quoted a northern rhyme: "Jing Mountain the upper gate, Floating Mountain the lower, Tong and Tuo the rushing trench, flooding Juye as one."
units.literal: Zu quoted a northern children's rhyme: "Jing Mountain is the upper gate, Floating Mountain the lower gate, Tong and Tuo the rushing ditch, together flooding Juye marsh."

units.zh: 高祖以爲然，使水工陳承伯、材官將軍祖暅視地形，咸謂淮內沙土漂輕，不堅實，其功不可就。
units.en: Gaozu agreed and sent Chen Chengbai and Zu Geng to survey; all said the Huai's sand was loose and shifting and the work would never hold.
units.literal: Gaozu thought it sound and sent hydraulic engineers Chen Chengbai and Works General Zu Chong to view the ground; all said the Huai's sand and silt were light and drifting, not firm, and the work could not succeed.

units.zh: 高祖弗納，發徐、揚人，率二十戶取五丁以築之。
units.en: Gaozu overruled them and drafted the people of Xu and Yang, taking five adult males from every twenty households.
units.literal: Gaozu would not accept it and mobilized men of Xu and Yang, taking five adult males from every twenty households.

units.zh: 假絢節、都督淮上諸軍事，並護堰作，役人及戰士，有衆二十萬。
units.en: Xuan received brevet staff, command on the Huai, and oversight of the dam—two hundred thousand workers and soldiers together.
units.literal: Xuan was given brevet staff and made Area Commander of all Huai military affairs, also overseeing the dam works; laborers and fighting men together numbered two hundred thousand.

units.zh: 於鐘離南起浮山，北抵巉石，依岸以築土，合脊於中流。
units.en: South of Zhongli they built Floating Mountain north to Jieshi, heaping earth along the shore until the crests joined in mid-river.
units.literal: South of Zhongli they raised Floating Mountain, north to Jieshi, piling earth along the banks until the ridge met in midstream.

units.zh: 十四年，堰將合，淮水漂疾，輒復決潰，衆患之。
units.en: In year fourteen, as the dam neared closure, the Huai surged and tore it open again and again, and the workers despaired.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, as the dam was about to close, the Huai raced wild and broke open again and again; the masses were distressed.

units.zh: 或謂江、淮多有蛟，能乘風雨決壞崖岸，其性惡鐵，因是引東西二冶鐵器，大則釜鬵，小則鋘鋤，數千萬斤，沉于堰所。
units.en: Some said dragons of the Jiang and Huai ride storms to burst earthworks and loathe iron; they hauled tens of millions of pounds of cauldrons, tripods, and hoes from eastern and western forges and sank them into the breach.
units.literal: Some said the Yangtze and Huai held many flood-dragons that ride wind and rain to burst banks and cliffs and hate iron; so they brought iron from east and west smelters, great cauldrons and tripods down to hoes, tens of millions of pounds, and sank them at the dam site.

units.zh: 猶不能合，乃伐樹爲井幹，填以巨石，加土其上。
units.en: Still the waters would not join; then they cut timber into well-curb cages, packed them with boulders, and piled earth on top.
units.literal: Still it would not close; then they felled trees for well-curb frames, filled them with great stones, and heaped earth above.

units.zh: 緣淮百里內，岡陵木石，無巨細必盡，負擔者肩上皆穿。
units.en: For a hundred li along the Huai every hill and tree and stone, large or small, was stripped bare; porters' shoulders wore to the bone.
units.literal: For a hundred li along the Huai, hill and wood and stone, none great or small, were utterly exhausted; bearers' shoulders were worn through.

units.zh: 夏日疾疫，死者相枕，蠅蟲晝夜聲相合。
units.en: Summer brought plague; corpses lay stacked and flies and gnats hummed without cease.
units.literal: In summer plague raged; the dead lay pillow to pillow and flies and gnats droned day and night as one sound.

units.zh: 高祖愍役人淹久，遣尚書右僕射袁昂、侍中謝舉假節慰勞之，并加蠲復。
units.en: Gaozu pitied their long labor and sent Yuan Ang and Xie Ju with brevet staff to comfort the workers and lighten their taxes.
units.literal: Gaozu pitied the laborers' long toil and sent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang and Attendant Xie Ju with brevet staff to comfort them and grant tax relief.

units.zh: 是冬又寒甚，淮、泗盡凍，士卒死者十七八，高祖復遣賜以衣袴。
units.en: Winter froze the Huai and Si; seven or eight in ten soldiers died of cold; Gaozu sent coats and trousers again.
units.literal: That winter cold was fierce too; the Huai and Si froze solid; soldiers died seven or eight in ten; Gaozu again sent gifts of coats and trousers.

units.zh: 十一月，魏遣將楊大眼揚聲決堰，絢命諸軍撤營露次以待之。
units.en: In the eleventh month Yang Dayan of Wei boasted he would break the dam; Xuan had the hosts break camp and wait in the open.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Wei sent General Yang Dayan, proclaiming he would burst the dam; Xuan ordered the armies to strike camp and bivouac in the open to await him.

units.zh: 遣其子悅挑戰，斬魏咸陽王府司馬徐方興，魏軍小卻。
units.en: He sent his son Yue to fight; Yue slew Xu Fangxing, major of the Prince of Xianyang's household, and Wei fell back a little.
units.literal: He sent his son Yue to offer challenge and beheaded Wei's Prince of Xianyang Household Major Xu Fangxing; the Wei army drew back a little.

units.zh: 十二月，魏遣其尚書僕射李曇定督衆軍來戰，絢與徐州刺史劉思祖等距之。
units.en: In the twelfth month Li Tanding of Wei led the armies; Xuan and Liu Sizu of Xuzhou met them.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Wei sent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Li Xianding to supervise the host in battle; Xuan with Xuzhou Inspector Liu Sigu and others faced them.

units.zh: 高祖又遣右衛將軍昌義之、太僕卿魚弘文、直閤曹世宗、徐元和相次距守。
units.en: Gaozu sent Chang Yizhi, Yu Hongwen, Cao Shizong, and Xu Yuanhe in turn to reinforce the defense.
units.literal: Gaozu also sent Right Guard General Chang Yizhi, Grand Master of the Stud Yu Hongwen, Palace Attendant Cao Shizong, and Xu Yuanhe in succession to hold the line.

units.zh: 十五年四月，堰乃成。
units.en: In year fifteen, fourth month, the dam closed at last.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, fourth month, the dam was finished at last.

units.zh: 其長九里，下闊一百四十丈，上廣四十五丈，高二十丈，深十九丈五尺。
units.en: It stretched nine li, one hundred forty zhang at the base, forty-five at the crown, twenty high, nineteen zhang five chi deep.
units.literal: It ran nine li long, one hundred forty zhang wide below, forty-five zhang wide above, twenty zhang high, nineteen zhang five chi deep.

units.zh: 夾之以堤，并樹杞柳，軍人安堵，列居其上。
units.en: Banks were flanked with dikes and planted with qi willow; the troops camped in ranks along the crest.
units.literal: Dikes flanked it and qi willow was planted together; soldiers settled in peace, ranked along its top.

units.zh: 其水清潔，俯視居人墳墓，了然皆在其下。
units.en: The water ran clear; looking down you could see the inhabitants' graves below, every one distinct.
units.literal: Its water was clear; looking down one saw the tombs of those who dwelt below, every one plain beneath.

units.zh: 或人謂絢曰：「四瀆，天所以節宣其氣，不可久塞。
units.en: A man told Xuan, "The four great rivers are how Heaven vents its breath—they cannot stay dammed forever.
units.literal: Someone said to Xuan: "The four waterways are Heaven's way of regulating breath; they cannot be blocked long.

units.zh: 若鑿湫東注，則遊波寬緩，堰得不壞。」
units.en: Open the sluice eastward and the flood will spread and ease—the dam may hold."
units.literal: If you cut the sluice to flow east, the wandering flood will spread wide and slow, and the dam may endure."

units.zh: 絢然之，開湫東注。
units.en: Xuan agreed and cut the eastern sluice.
units.literal: Xuan agreed and opened the sluice to the east.

units.zh: 又縱反間于魏曰：「梁人所懼開湫，不畏野戰。」
units.en: He also fed Wei a lie: "Liang fears the sluice, not open battle."
units.literal: He also planted false reports in Wei: "What men of Liang fear is opening the sluice; they do not fear field battle."

units.zh: 魏人信之，果鑿山深五丈，開湫北注，水日夜分流，湫猶不減。
units.en: Wei believed him and dug five zhang into the mountain, opening the sluice north; water split day and night yet the sluice barely fell.
units.literal: The Wei men believed it and indeed cut the mountain five zhang deep, opening the sluice to pour north; water divided day and night yet the sluice did not lessen.

units.zh: 其月，魏軍竟潰而歸。
units.en: That month Wei broke and marched home.
units.literal: That month the Wei army at last broke and returned.

units.zh: 水之所及，夾淮方數百里地。
units.en: The flood spread several hundred li along both banks of the Huai.
units.literal: Where the waters reached, land along both banks of the Huai for several hundred li was flooded.

units.zh: 魏壽陽城戍稍徙頓於八公山，此南居人散就岡壟。
units.en: Wei's Shouyang garrison drew back toward Eight-Dukes Mountain; south of there people fled to the hills.
units.literal: Wei's Shouyang garrison slowly shifted its halt to Eight-Dukes Mountain; south of this the inhabitants scattered to hills and ridges.

units.zh: 初，堰起於徐州界，刺史張豹子宣言於境，謂己必尸其事。
units.en: When the dam began on Xuzhou soil, Inspector Zhang Baozi announced in his district that the work was his to command.
units.literal: At first, when the dam rose on the border of Xuzhou, Inspector Zhang Baozi proclaimed within his circuit that he himself would surely oversee the work.

units.zh: 旣而絢以他官來監作，豹子甚慚。
units.en: Then Xuan arrived in another post to oversee the work and Baozi burned with shame.
units.literal: Afterward Xuan came in another office to supervise construction and Baozi was deeply ashamed.

units.zh: 俄而敕豹子受絢節度，每事輒先諮焉，由是遂譖絢與魏交通，高祖雖不納，猶以事畢征絢。
units.en: Soon Baozi was ordered under Xuan's command and had to consult him on everything; he then accused Xuan of dealing with Wei; Gaozu dismissed the charge but recalled Xuan when the work was done.
units.literal: Soon an edict made Baozi accept Xuan's command; in every matter he first consulted him, and from this he slandered Xuan as trafficking with Wei; Gaozu did not accept it, yet when the work ended still summoned Xuan away.

units.zh: 尋以絢爲持節、都督司州諸軍事、信武將軍、司州刺史，領安陸太守，增封二百戶。
units.en: Soon he took staff, command of Si, Trustworthy Martial General, the inspectorate, Anlu as well, and two hundred added households.
units.literal: Before long Xuan was made Holder of Staff, Area Commander of Si province military affairs, Trustworthy Martial General, Si Inspector, and concurrently Administrator of Anlu, with two hundred added households on his fief.

units.zh: 絢還後，豹子不脩堰，至其秋八月，淮水暴長，堰悉壞決，奔流于海，祖暅坐下獄。
units.en: After Xuan left, Baozi let the dam rot; in autumn of the eighth month the Huai burst and the whole work collapsed into the sea, and Zu Geng went to prison.
units.literal: After Xuan left, Baozi did not maintain the dam; by autumn in the eighth month the Huai swelled violently and the dam broke entirely, rushing to the sea, and Zu Geng was imprisoned.

units.zh: 絢在州三年，大修城隍，號爲嚴政。
units.en: For three years in office he rebuilt walls and ditches and was famed for stern government.
units.literal: Xuan held the province three years, greatly repairing walls and moats, and was known for stern rule.

units.zh: 十八年，徵爲員外散騎常侍，領長水校尉，與護軍韋叡、太子右衛率周捨直殿省。
units.en: In the eighteenth year, Xuan was summoned as Supernumerary Regular Attendant and concurrently Changshui Colonel; together with Protector of the Army Wei Rui and Crown Prince Right Guard Commander Zhou She, he served on duty in the palace departments.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, Xuan was summoned as Supernumerary Regular Attendant and concurrently Changshui Colonel; together with Protector of the Army Wei Rui and Crown Prince Right Guard Commander Zhou She, he served on duty in the palace departments.

units.zh: 普通元年，除衛尉卿，未拜，卒，時年五十七。
units.en: In Putong 1, he was appointed Commandant of the Guards but died before taking office, aged fifty-seven.
units.literal: In Putong 1, he was appointed Commandant of the Guards but died before taking office, aged fifty-seven.

units.zh: 輿駕卽日臨哭。
units.en: The imperial carriage came that same day to visit and mourn him.
units.literal: The imperial carriage came that same day to visit and mourn him.

units.zh: 贈右衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: He was posthumously granted the office of Right Guard General and given one corps of drummers and pipers.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the office of Right Guard General and given one corps of drummers and pipers.

units.zh: 賻錢十萬，布百匹。
units.en: He was granted funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.
units.literal: He was granted funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.

units.zh: 諡曰壯。
units.en: His posthumous title was Zhuang.
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhuang.

units.zh: 絢寬和少喜懼，在朝廷，見人如不能言，號爲長厚。
units.en: Xuan was mild and seldom showed joy or fear; in court he looked as though he could not find words, and men called him generous and honest.
units.literal: Xuan was easygoing and seldom showed joy or fear; at court he seemed before others as if he could not speak, and was called generous and honest.

units.zh: 在省，每寒月見省官繿縷，輒遺以襦衣，其好施如此。
units.en: In the ministries, whenever winter showed an officer in tatters, he sent a padded coat—so he gave.
units.literal: In the ministries, whenever in cold months he saw officials in rags, he would send them padded coats—such was his habit of giving.

units.zh: 子悅嗣。
units.en: His son Yue inherited.
units.literal: His son Yue succeeded.

units.zh: 昌義之，歷陽烏江人也。
units.en: Chang Yizhi came from Wujiang in Liyang.
units.literal: Chang Yizhi came from Wujiang in Liyang.

units.zh: 少有武幹。
units.en: From youth he had military ability.
units.literal: From youth he had military ability.

units.zh: 齊代隨曹虎征伐，累有戰功。
units.en: During Qi, he accompanied Cao Hu on campaigns and repeatedly won battle merit.
units.literal: During Qi, he accompanied Cao Hu on campaigns and repeatedly won battle merit.

units.zh: 虎爲雍州，以義之補防閤，出爲馮翊戍主。
units.en: When Hu governed Yongzhou, he appointed Yizhi to the guard staff, then sent him out as garrison commander at Fengyi.
units.literal: When Hu governed Yongzhou, he appointed Yizhi to the guard staff, then sent him out as garrison commander at Fengyi.

units.zh: 及虎代還，義之留事高祖。
units.en: When Hu was replaced and returned, Yizhi stayed behind to serve Gaozu.
units.literal: When Hu was replaced and returned, Yizhi stayed behind to serve Gaozu.

units.zh: 時天下方亂，高祖亦厚遇之。
units.en: At the time the realm was just falling into disorder, and Gaozu treated him generously.
units.literal: At the time the realm was just falling into disorder, and Gaozu treated him generously.

units.zh: 義師起，板爲輔國將軍、軍主，除建安王中兵參軍。
units.en: When the righteous army rose, he was provisionally appointed General Who Supports the State and army commander, and was appointed central army aide to the Prince of Jian'an.
units.literal: When the righteous army rose, he was provisionally appointed General Who Supports the State and army commander, and was appointed central army aide to the Prince of Jian'an.

units.zh: 時竟陵芊口有邸閣，高祖遣驅，每戰必捷。
units.en: At the time there were granaries at Qiankou in Jingling; Gaozu sent him to operate there, and he was victorious in every battle.
units.literal: At the time there were granaries at Qiankou in Jingling; Gaozu sent him to operate there, and he was victorious in every battle.

units.zh: 大軍次新林，隨王茂於新亭，幷朱雀航力戰，斬獲尤多。
units.en: When the main army halted at Xinlin, he followed Wang Mao at Xinting and fought hard at Zhuque Bridge as well, taking especially many heads and captives.
units.literal: When the main army halted at Xinlin, he followed Wang Mao at Xinting and fought hard at Zhuque Bridge as well, taking especially many heads and captives.

units.zh: 建康城平，以爲直閤將軍、馬右夾轂主。
units.en: After Jiankang was pacified, he was made Direct-Hall General and commander of the right horsemen flanking the imperial carriage.
units.literal: After Jiankang was pacified, he was made Direct-Hall General and commander of the right horsemen flanking the imperial carriage.

units.zh: 天監元年，封永豊縣侯，邑五百戶。
units.en: In Tianjian 1, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongfeng county, with a fief of five hundred households.
units.literal: In Tianjian 1, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongfeng county, with a fief of five hundred households.

units.zh: 除驍騎將軍。
units.en: He was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.
units.literal: He was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.

units.zh: 出爲盱眙太守。
units.en: He went out as administrator of Xuyi.
units.literal: He went out as administrator of Xuyi.

units.zh: 二年，遷假節、督北徐州諸軍事、輔國將軍、北徐州刺史，鎮鐘離。
units.en: In the second year, he was transferred as Acting Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in North Xuzhou, General Who Supports the State, and inspector of North Xuzhou, garrisoning Zhongli.
units.literal: In the second year, he was transferred as Acting Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in North Xuzhou, General Who Supports the State, and inspector of North Xuzhou, garrisoning Zhongli.

units.zh: 魏寇州境，義之擊破之。
units.en: When Wei raided the provincial borders, Yizhi struck and defeated them.
units.literal: When Wei raided the provincial borders, Yizhi struck and defeated them.

units.zh: 三年，進號冠軍將軍，增封二百戶。
units.en: In the third year, his title was advanced to Champion General and his fief was increased by two hundred households.
units.literal: In the third year, his title was advanced to Champion General and his fief was increased by two hundred households.

units.zh: 四年，大舉北伐，揚州刺史臨川王督衆軍軍洛口，義之以州兵受節度，爲前軍，攻魏梁城戍，克之。
units.en: In year four came the great northern expedition; the Prince of Linchuan commanded from Luokou; Yizhi's provincial army served as vanguard, stormed Wei's Liangcheng garrison, and took it.
units.literal: In the fourth year a great northern campaign was launched; the Prince of Linchuan as Yangzhou Inspector directed the armies from Luokou; Yizhi's provincial troops accepted his command as vanguard and attacked Wei's Liangcheng garrison and took it.

units.zh: 五年，高祖以征役久，有詔班師，衆軍各退散，魏中山王元英乘勢追躡，攻沒馬頭，城內糧儲，魏悉移之歸北。
units.en: In year five Gaozu ordered withdrawal after the long campaign; as the hosts scattered, Yuan Ying of Wei pursued, seized Matou, and hauled every grain store north.
units.literal: In the fifth year Gaozu, because the campaign had run long, issued an edict to withdraw the armies; the hosts dispersed each to their own; Wei's Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying seized the moment to pursue, took Matou, and moved all grain stores within the walls north.

units.zh: 議者咸曰：「魏運米北歸，當無復南向。」
units.en: The counselors said, "Wei hauls grain north—they will not come south again."
units.literal: Counselors all said: "Wei is moving grain north; they surely will not march south again."

units.zh: 高祖曰：「不然，此必進兵，非其實也。」
units.en: Gaozu said, "No. This is a feint for advance, not retreat."
units.literal: Gaozu said: "Not so—this is surely an advance in force, not their true intent."

units.zh: 乃遣土匠修塹營鐘離城，敕義之爲戰守之備。
units.en: He sent laborers to dig trenches and strengthen Zhongli and told Yizhi to ready for siege and defense.
units.literal: He then sent earthworkers to repair ditches and fortify Zhongli, charging Yizhi to prepare for battle and defense.

units.zh: 是冬，英果率其安樂王元道明、平東將軍楊大眼等衆數十萬，來寇鐘離。
units.en: That winter Ying came with Yuan Daoming, Yang Dayan, and hundreds of thousands to strike Zhongli.
units.literal: That winter Ying indeed led his Prince of Anle Yuan Daoming, Quelling East General Yang Dayan, and a host of several hundred thousand to raid Zhongli.

units.zh: 鐘離城北阻淮水，魏人於邵陽洲西岸作浮橋，跨淮通道。
units.en: North of Zhongli lay the Huai; Wei built a floating bridge from Shaoyang Isle's west bank to cross the river.
units.literal: Zhongli's north was blocked by the Huai; the Wei men built a floating bridge on the west bank of Shaoyang Isle to cross the Huai as a road.

units.zh: 英據東岸，大眼據西岸，以攻城。
units.en: Ying held the east bank, Dayan the west, and together they besieged the walls.
units.literal: Ying held the east bank, Dayan the west, and together they pressed the assault on the city.

units.zh: 時城中衆才三千人，義之督帥，隨方抗禦。
units.en: Only three thousand men held the city; Yizhi commanded and met each assault where it fell.
units.literal: At the time the men in the city were only three thousand; Yizhi directed the defense and met each threat as it came.

units.zh: 魏軍乃以車載土填塹，使其衆負土隨之，嚴騎自後蹙焉。
units.en: Wei loaded carts with earth for the moat and drove the people forward with earth on their backs, cavalry pressing from behind.
units.literal: The Wei army then loaded earth on carts to fill the moat and made the masses carry earth behind them, with stern cavalry from the rear driving them on.

units.zh: 人有未及回者，因以土迮之，俄而塹滿。
units.en: Men who could not turn in time were buried under their own loads; soon the ditch was full.
units.literal: Whoever could not turn back in time was buried by the earth they bore; soon the moat was full.

units.zh: 英與大眼躬自督戰，晝夜苦攻，分番相代，墜而復升，莫有退者。
units.en: Ying and Dayan fought in person, attacking day and night in relays; men fell from the walls and climbed back, none yielding.
units.literal: Ying and Dayan themselves directed the fight, attacking bitterly day and night in rotating shifts; men fell and climbed again, none retreating.

units.zh: 又設飛樓及沖車撞之，所值城土輒頹落。
units.en: They raised flying towers and battering rams; each blow shook earth from the walls.
units.literal: They also set flying towers and battering rams; wherever they struck, the city earth crumbled.

units.zh: 義之乃以泥補缺，沖車雖入而不能壞。
units.en: Yizhi smeared the breaches with mud; the rams entered the gap yet could not bring the wall down.
units.literal: Yizhi then patched the gaps with mud; though the rams entered they could not break the wall.

units.zh: 義之善射，其被攻危急之處，輒馳往救之，每彎弓所向，莫不應弦而倒。
units.en: Yizhi shot well; wherever the fight turned desperate he rode to it, and every arrow he loosed dropped its man.
units.literal: Yizhi was skilled at archery; wherever the assault grew desperate he galloped to save it, and every bowshot he loosed felled its man without fail.

units.zh: 一日戰數十合，前後殺傷者萬計，魏軍死者與城平。
units.en: They fought dozens of clashes in a day; casualties mounted to the tens of thousands, and Wei's dead piled even with the ramparts.
units.literal: In a single day they fought several tens of rounds; dead and wounded before and behind ran to the ten thousands, and Wei's slain were level with the wall.

units.zh: 六年四月，高祖遣曹景宗、韋睿帥衆二十萬救焉，旣至，與魏戰，大破之，英、大眼等各脫身奔走。
units.en: In year six, fourth month, Gaozu sent Cao Jingzong and Wei Rui with two hundred thousand; they met Wei and shattered them; Ying and Dayan fled for their lives.
units.literal: In the sixth year, fourth month, Gaozu sent Cao Jingzong and Wei Rui leading two hundred thousand men to rescue them; when they arrived they fought Wei and broke them utterly; Ying, Dayan, and the rest each fled for their lives.

units.zh: 義之因率輕兵追至洛口而還。
units.en: Yizhi led light horse in pursuit to Luokou and turned back.
units.literal: Yizhi then led light troops in pursuit to Luokou and returned.

units.zh: 斬首俘生，不可勝計。
units.en: He beheaded the enemy and took captives beyond count.
units.literal: Heads cut and captives taken alive beyond counting.

units.zh: 以功進號軍師將軍，增封二百戶，遷持節、督青冀二州諸軍事、征虜將軍、青冀二州刺史。
units.en: For merit he was advanced to Army Adviser General, his fief increased by two hundred households, and he was transferred to Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of Qing and Ji military affairs, General Who Campaigns Against the Caitiffs, and Inspector of Qing and Ji.
units.literal: For merit he was advanced to Army Adviser General, his fief increased by two hundred households, and he was transferred to Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of all Qing and Ji military affairs, General Who Campaigns Against the Caitiffs, and Inspector of Qing and Ji.

units.zh: 未拜，改督南兗兗徐青冀五州諸軍事、輔國將軍、南兗州刺史。
units.en: Before taking post he was reassigned to command five provinces' military affairs—South Yan, Yan, Xu, Qing, and Ji—as assists-the-state general and South Yan inspector.
units.literal: Before he took the appointment he was changed to Area Commander of all military affairs in South Yan, Yan, Xu, Qing, and Ji, Assists-the-State General, and South Yan Inspector.

units.zh: 坐禁物出籓，爲有司所奏免。
units.en: For exporting prohibited goods from his fief, the censors impeached him and he was dismissed.
units.literal: He was impeached and dismissed by the relevant offices for sending forbidden goods out of his fief.

units.zh: 其年，補朱衣直閤，除左驍騎將軍，直閤如故。
units.en: That year he was added as vermilion-robe direct attendant, made left raiding cavalry general, and kept his direct-attendant post.
units.literal: That year he was made up as Vermilion-Robe Direct Attendant, appointed Left Raiding Cavalry General, Direct Attendant as before.

units.zh: 遷太子右衛率，領越騎校尉，假節。
units.en: He became right commandant of the crown prince's guard, also colonel of the upright cavalry, with acting credentials.
units.literal: He was transferred to Right Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard, concurrently Colonel of the Upright Cavalry, with acting credentials.

units.zh: 八年，出爲持節、督湘州諸軍事、征遠將軍、湘州刺史。
units.en: In year eight he went out with credentials, as area commander of Xiang, far-campaign general, and Xiang inspector.
units.literal: In the eighth year he went out as Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of all Xiangzhou military affairs, Far-Campaign General, and Xiang Inspector.

units.zh: 九年，以本號還朝，俄爲司空臨川王司馬，將軍如故。
units.en: In year nine he returned to court under his old title; soon he was staff officer to the prince of Linchuan, minister of works, general as before.
units.literal: In the ninth year he returned to court with his former title; soon he was made Staff Officer to the Minister of Works, Prince of Linchuan, general as before.

units.zh: 十年，遷右衛將軍。
units.en: In year ten he became right palace guard general.
units.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Right Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 十三年，徙爲左衛將軍。
units.en: In year thirteen he was made left palace guard general.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was moved to Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 是冬，高祖遣太子右衛率康絢督衆軍作荊山堰。
units.en: That winter Gaozu sent Kang Xuan, right commandant of the crown prince's guard, to oversee all forces building the Jingshan dam.
units.literal: That winter Gaozu sent the Crown Prince's Right Commandant Kang Xuan to supervise all armies in building the Jingshan Dam.

units.zh: 明年，魏遣將李曇定大衆逼荊山，揚聲欲決堰，詔假義之節，帥太僕卿魚弘文、直閤將軍曹世宗、徐元和等救絢，軍未至，絢等已破魏軍。
units.en: Next year Wei sent Li Tanding with a large force against Jingshan, claiming they would burst the dam; Yizhi was given acting credentials and led Yu Hongwen, grand master of the imperial stud, direct-attendant Cao Shizong, Xu Yuanhe, and others to aid Xuan—the relief force had not arrived when Xuan had already routed Wei.
units.literal: The next year Wei sent the general Li Tanding with a great host to press Jingshan, proclaiming they would breach the dam; an edict lent Yizhi credentials; he led Grand Master of the Imperial Stud Yu Hongwen, Direct-Attendant General Cao Shizong, Xu Yuanhe, and others to rescue Xuan—the army had not arrived when Xuan and his men had already broken the Wei forces.

units.zh: 魏又遣大將李平攻峽石，圍直閤將軍趙祖悅，義之又率朱衣直閤王神念等救之。
units.en: Wei again sent Li Ping against Xiashi and besieged Zhao Zuyue; Yizhi again led vermilion-robe direct attendant Wang Shennian and others to the relief.
units.literal: Wei again sent the great general Li Ping to attack Xiashi, besieging Direct-Attendant General Zhao Zuyue; Yizhi again led Vermilion-Robe Direct Attendant Wang Shennian and others to rescue him.

units.zh: 時魏兵盛，神念攻峽石浮橋不能克，故援兵不得時進，遂陷峽石。
units.en: Wei was strong; Shennian failed to take Xiashi's pontoon bridge, the relief could not come up in time, and the place fell.
units.literal: At the time Wei troops were strong; Shennian attacked the Xiashi pontoon bridge but could not take it, so the relief army could not advance in time, and Xiashi fell.

units.zh: 義之班師，爲有司所奏，高祖以其功臣，不問也。
units.en: Yizhi withdrew and was impeached; Gaozu, treating him as a meritorious minister, let the matter drop.
units.literal: Yizhi withdrew the army and was impeached by the relevant offices; Gaozu, because he was a meritorious minister, did not pursue it.

units.zh: 十五年，復以爲使持節、都督湘州諸軍事、信威將軍、湘州刺史。
units.en: In year fifteen he was again made full-credentials bearer, commander of Xiang military affairs, trustworthy martial general, and Xiang inspector.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he was again made Bearer of Full Credentials, Commander of all Xiangzhou military affairs, Trustworthy Martial General, and Xiang Inspector.

units.zh: 其年，改授都督北徐州緣淮諸軍事、平北將軍、北徐州刺史。
units.en: That year he was reassigned to command North Xuzhou forces along the Huai as pacification north general and North Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: That year he was reassigned Commander of all North Xuzhou military affairs along the Huai, Pacification North General, and North Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 義之性寬厚，爲將能撫御，得人死力，及居籓任，吏民安之。
units.en: Generous by nature, Yizhi as a general won men to die for him; in a provincial post officials and commoners were secure.
units.literal: Yizhi was by nature generous and mild; as a general he could comfort and control men and win their utmost loyalty; when he held a fief post, officials and people were at peace.

units.zh: 俄給鼓吹一部，改封營道縣侯，邑戶如先。
units.en: Soon he received martial pipes and drums and was re-enfeoffed as Marquis of Yingdao with the same household quota.
units.literal: Soon he was granted one set of martial pipes and drums; his enfeoffment was changed to Marquis of Yingdao county, the fief households as before.

units.zh: 普通三年，徵爲護軍將軍，鼓吹如故。
units.en: In Putong year three he was summoned as protector of the army general, pipes and drums unchanged.
units.literal: In the third year of Putong he was summoned to be Protector of the Army General, martial pipes and drums as before.

units.zh: 四年十月，卒。
units.en: In the tenth month of year four he died.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year he died.

units.zh: 高祖深痛惜之，詔曰：「護軍將軍、營道縣開國侯昌義之，幹略沉濟，志懷寬隱，誠著運始，效彰邊服。
units.en: Gaozu mourned him deeply and decreed: "Protector of the Army General, founding Marquis of Yingdao, Chang Yizhi—deeply capable in counsel, mild of heart, loyal from the dynasty's rise, his merit plain on the border.
units.literal: Gaozu grieved deeply and issued an edict: "Protector of the Army General, Marquis of Yingdao, founder of the fief-state Chang Yizhi—capable and steady in counsel, generous and reserved in intent, loyalty manifest from the founding of our fortune, achievements clear on the frontier.

units.zh: 方申爪牙，寄以禁旅；
units.en: He was just to prove his worth when we entrusted him with the palace guard;
units.literal: Just as he was to show his talons and fangs, we entrusted him with the palace guard;

units.zh: 奄至殞喪，惻愴于懷。
units.en: Sudden death moves me to grief.
units.literal: Suddenly reaching death and ruin, I am pained in the breast.

units.zh: 可贈散騎常侍、車騎將軍，并鼓吹一部。
units.en: Posthumously he shall be made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Chariot and Cavalry General, with pipes and drums as well.
units.literal: He may be posthumously made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of Chariots and Cavalry, with one set of martial pipes and drums as well.

units.zh: 給東園秘器，朝服一具。
units.en: Eastern Garden funeral gear and one court robe.
units.literal: Funerary goods from the Eastern Garden store, one set of court dress.

units.zh: 賻錢二萬，布二百匹，蠟二百斤。
units.en: Funeral bounty: twenty thousand cash, two hundred bolts of cloth, two hundred jin of wax.
units.literal: Funeral bounty: twenty thousand cash, two hundred bolts of cloth, two hundred jin of wax.

units.zh: 諡曰烈。」
units.en: Posthumous title: Lie (Stalwart)."
units.literal: Posthumous title: Lie (Stalwart)."

units.zh: 子寶業嗣，官至直閤將軍、譙州刺史。
units.en: His son Baoye succeeded and rose to direct-attendant general and Qiao inspector.
units.literal: His son Baoye succeeded; he reached Direct-Attendant General and Qiao Inspector.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：張惠紹、馮道根、康絢、昌義之，初起從上，其功則輕。
units.en: Chen minister of personnel Yao Cha said: Zhang Huishao, Feng Daogen, Kang Xuan, and Chang Yizhi—when they first followed the founding, their merit was slight.
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Zhang Huishao, Feng Daogen, Kang Xuan, and Chang Yizhi—at first following the ascent, their achievements were light.

units.zh: 及羣盜焚門，而惠紹以力戰顯；
units.en: When rioters torched the gates, Huishao distinguished himself in battle;
units.literal: When bandits burned the palace gates, Huishao showed himself in fierce battle;

units.zh: 合肥、邵陽之逼，而道根、義之功多；
units.en: At Hefei and Shaoyang, Daogen and Yizhi did the heavier work;
units.literal: At the pressures of Hefei and Shaoyang, Daogen and Yizhi had the greater merit;

units.zh: 浮山之役起，而康絢典其事：互有厥勞，寵進宜矣。
units.en: When the Fushan affair began, Kang Xuan ran it: each earned his place—favor was rightly granted.
units.literal: When the Fushan campaign arose, Kang Xuan directed it—they each had their share of labor; advancement in favor was fitting.

units.zh: 先是鎮星守天江而堰興，及退舍而堰決，非徒人事，有天道矣。
units.en: When Saturn held the Heavenly River the dam rose; when it moved off the dam broke—not human effort alone—Heaven was involved.
units.literal: Earlier, when the Planet of Settlement held the Heavenly River the dam arose; when it withdrew the dam burst—not merely human affairs; Heaven had a hand.

units.zh: 師次郢城，茂進平加湖，破光子衿、吳子陽等，斬馘萬計，還獻捷于漢川。
units.en: When the army reached Yingcheng, Mao advanced to pacify Jiahu, defeated Guang Ziqin, Wu Ziyang, and others, took tens of thousands of heads, and returned to report victory at Hanchuan.
units.literal: When the army halted at Ying city, Mao advanced and pacified Jiahu, defeated Guang Ziqin, Wu Ziyang, and others, and decapitations numbered in the tens of thousands; he returned and presented the victory at Hanchuan.

units.zh: 高祖爲之流涕，顧謂謝舉曰：「孔休源奉職清忠，當官正直，方欲共康治道，以隆王化。
units.en: Gaozu wept and, turning to Xie Ju, said: "Kong Xiuyuan served with pure loyalty and upright integrity. I had hoped to build good government with him and elevate the kingly way.
units.literal: The Emperor wept for him and, turning to Xie Ju, said: "Kong Xiuyuan served his office with pure loyalty, upright as an official; I had hoped to jointly bring about good government and elevate kingly transformation.

units.zh: 舉曰：「此人清介強直，當今罕有，微臣竊爲陛下惜之。」
units.en: Ju replied: "He was incorruptible and resolute—a man rarely seen today. Your servant grieves for Your Majesty's loss."
units.literal: Ju said: "This man was pure and upright, strong and straight—rare today; your humble servant privately mourns him for Your Majesty."

units.zh: 是歲，江州刺史陳伯之舉兵叛，茂出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督江州諸軍事、征南將軍、江州刺史，給鼓吹一部，南討伯之。
units.en: That year Chen Bozhi rebelled as Jiangzhou inspector; Mao went out with staff insignia as Scattered Cavalry Attendant, area commander, Pacify the South General, and Jiangzhou inspector, with drums and pipes, to attack him.
units.literal: That year Jiangzhou Inspector Chen Bozhi raised troops in rebellion; Mao went out as Bearer of Staff, Scattered Cavalry Attendant, Area Commander of Jiangzhou military affairs, Pacify the South General, and Jiangzhou Inspector, granted one suite of drums and pipes, and marched south to attack Bozhi.

units.zh: 伯之奔于魏。
units.en: Bozhi fled to Wei.
units.literal: Bozhi fled to Wei.

units.zh: 十二年，魏將傅豎眼寇南安，齊率衆距之，豎眼退走。
units.en: In year twelve Wei general Fu Shuyan attacked Nan'an; Qi resisted and Shuyan withdrew.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, Wei general Fu Shuyan invaded Nan'an; Qi led the host to resist him, and Shuyan withdrew.

units.zh: 而魏更增傅豎眼兵，復來拒戰，齊兵少不利，軍引還，於是葭萌復沒於魏。
units.en: Wei reinforced Fu Shuyan and fought again; with too few men Qi fared ill and withdrew, and Jiameng fell back to Wei.
units.literal: But Wei increased Fu Shuyan's troops and came again to resist; Qi's army was few and met with ill fortune, the army drew back, and so Jiameng again fell to Wei.

units.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩
units.en: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
units.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

units.zh: 張稷字公喬，吳郡人也。
units.en: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a man of Wu commandery.
units.literal: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a native of Wu commandery.

units.zh: 張稷因機制變，亦其時也。
units.en: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.
units.literal: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，以功封江安縣侯，邑一千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for merit, with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for his merit, with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 時魏寇壽春，以稷爲寧朔將軍、軍主，副尚書僕射沈文季鎮豫州。
units.en: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made pacifying-the-north general and army commander, assisting right vice director Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.
units.literal: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made Pacifying the North General and army commander, assisting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督青、冀二州諸軍事、安北將軍、青、冀二州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of credentials, cavalier attendant, area commander of Qing and Ji, Pacification North general, and inspector of Qing and Ji.
units.literal: He went out as Bearer of Credentials, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Area Commander of Qing and Ji military affairs, Pacification North General, and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

units.zh: 父永，宋右光祿大夫。
units.en: His father Yong was Song right grand master of splendid happiness.
units.literal: His father Yong was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

units.zh: 稷所生母遘疾歷時，稷始年十一，夜不解衣而養，永異之。
units.en: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he would not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.
