units.literal: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he did not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.

units.zh: 性疏率，朗悟有才略，與族兄充、融、卷等俱知名，時稱之曰：「充融卷稷，是爲四張。」
units.en: By nature he was careless and open, bright with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them, "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."
units.literal: By nature he was careless and open, bright and perceptive with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them: "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."

units.zh: 齊永明中，爲剡縣令，略不視事，多爲山水遊。
units.en: In Qi's Yongming era he was Shan county magistrate, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.
units.literal: In Qi's Yongming era he was Governor of Shan County, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.

units.zh: 梁臺建，爲散騎常侍、中書令。
units.en: When the Liang court was set up he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and director of the secretariat.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established he was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 會賊唐㝢之作亂，稷率厲縣人，保全縣境。
units.en: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.
units.literal: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.

units.zh: 尋徵還，爲持節、輔國將軍、都督北徐州諸軍事、北徐州刺史。
units.en: Soon recalled, he became bearer of credentials, General Who Assists the State, area commander of North Xuzhou, and North Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled and made Bearer of Credentials, General Who Assists the State, Area Commander of all North Xuzhou military affairs, and North Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 北徐州刺史王珍國就稷謀之，乃使直閤張齊害東昏于含德殿。
units.en: North Xuzhou inspector Wang Zhenguo plotted with Ji; Ji had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.
units.literal: North Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhenguo consulted with Ji; Ji then had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.

units.zh: 又爲侍中、國子祭酒，領驍騎將軍，遷護軍將軍、揚州大中正，以事免。
units.en: He again became attendant within and chancellor of the National University, with concurrent rapid cavalry general; he became protector general and Yangzhou chief rectifier, then was dismissed over an affair.
units.literal: He was again made Attendant Within and Chancellor of the National University, with concurrent Rapid Cavalry General; he was transferred to Protector General and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, then dismissed over an affair.

units.zh: 尋爲度支尚書、前將軍、太子右衛率，又以公事免。
units.en: Soon he became minister of revenue, front general, and right crown prince palace guard commander, then was again dismissed over official business.
units.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Revenue, Front General, and Right Crown Prince Palace Guard Commander, then again dismissed over an official matter.

units.zh: 州人徐道角等夜襲州城，害稷，時年六十三。
units.en: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others attacked the seat by night and killed Ji, aged sixty-three.
units.literal: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others night-attacked the provincial seat and killed Ji; he was sixty-three.

units.zh: 有司奏削爵土。
units.en: The responsible office memorialized to strip his fief and lands.
units.literal: The responsible office memorialized to strip his enfeoffment and lands.

units.zh: 稷兼衛尉，副王瑩都督城內諸軍事。
units.en: Ji held the concurrent guard commandancy and assisted Wang Ying in commanding the city's forces.
units.literal: Ji held the concurrent commandantship and assisted Wang Ying in commanding all military affairs within the city.

units.zh: 稷召尚書右僕射王亮等列坐殿前西鐘下，謂曰：「昔桀有昏德，鼎遷于殷；
units.en: Ji summoned Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others to sit before the western bell in the hall and said, "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;
units.literal: Ji summoned Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang and others to sit in a row before the western bell in the hall and said: "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;

units.zh: 商紂暴虐，鼎遷于周。
units.en: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.
units.literal: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.

units.zh: 今獨夫自絕于天，四海已歸聖主，斯實微子去殷之時，項伯歸漢之日，可不勉哉！」
units.en: Now the tyrant has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"
units.literal: Now the lone man has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is truly the time of Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"

units.zh: 稷性烈亮，善與人交。
units.en: Ji was fierce and bright, and good at friendship.
units.literal: Ji's nature was fierce and bright, and he was good at making friends.

units.zh: 歷官無蓄聚，俸祿皆頒之親故，家無餘財。
units.en: He never hoarded in office; he gave his salary to kin and friends, and his house held no surplus.
units.literal: In office he never accumulated wealth; his salary he always distributed to kin and friends, and his house had no surplus.

units.zh: 永元末，徵爲侍中，宿衛宮城。
units.en: At the end of Yongyuan he was summoned as attendant within and guarded the palace city.
units.literal: At the end of the Yongyuan era he was summoned as Attendant Within and guarded the palace city.

units.zh: 會魏軍退，仍出爲散騎常侍、將軍，吳興太守，秩中二千石。
units.en: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as cavalier attendant and general, Wuxing administrator, at salary rank two thousand dan.
units.literal: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General, Wuxing Administrator, with salary rank at two thousand dan.

units.zh: 武陵王曅爲護軍，轉護軍司馬，尋爲本州治中。
units.en: When the prince of Wuling was guard general, Ji was transferred to guard general staff officer, soon made chief administrator of his native province.
units.literal: When Prince of Wuling Ye was Guard General, Ji was transferred to Guard General Staff Officer, soon made Chief Administrator of his native province.

units.zh: 明帝領牧，仍爲別駕。
units.en: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as vice governor.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as Vice Governor.

units.zh: 魏衆稱百萬，圍城累日，時經略處分，文季悉委稷焉。
units.en: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.
units.literal: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.

units.zh: 時雍州刺史曹虎度樊城岸，以稷知州事。
units.en: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was put in charge of provincial affairs.
units.literal: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was made acting administrator of the province.

units.zh: 魏師退，稷還荊州，就拜黃門侍郎，復爲司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing province and was at once appointed yellow gate gentleman, again made staff officer and governor of Xinxing and Yongning.
units.literal: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing Province and was at once appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, again made Staff Officer and Governor of both Xinxing and Yongning commanderies.

units.zh: 乃遣國子博士范雲、舍人裴長穆等使石頭城詣高祖，高祖以稷爲侍中、左衛將軍。
units.en: Then he sent National University erudite Fan Yun, attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to see Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji attendant within and left palace guard general.
units.literal: Then he sent National University Erudite Fan Yun, Attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to present themselves to Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji Attendant Within and Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 高祖總百揆，遷大司馬左司馬。
units.en: When Gaozu took charge of all affairs, Ji became the grand marshal's left staff officer.
units.literal: When Gaozu oversaw all state affairs, Ji was transferred to Left Staff Officer of the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 輿駕將欲如稷宅，以盛暑，留幸僕射省，舊臨幸供具皆酬太官饌直，帝以稷清貧，手詔不受。
units.en: The emperor was about to visit Ji's house; in the intense heat he stayed at the vice director's office instead. Old custom reimbursed visit supplies from the Grand Provisioner; because Ji was poor, the emperor personally issued an edict that he accept nothing.
units.literal: The imperial carriage was about to visit Ji's house; because of the intense heat the Emperor stayed instead at the Vice Director's office. By old custom items for an imperial visit were reimbursed from the Grand Provisioner's feast allowance; because Ji was pure and poor, the Emperor personally issued an edict that he should not accept them.

units.zh: 會魏寇朐山，詔稷權頓六里，都督衆軍。
units.en: When Wei invaded Qushan, Ji was ordered to hold Liuli temporarily and command all armies.
units.literal: When Wei invaded Qushan, an edict ordered Ji to station temporarily at Liuli and command all armies.

units.zh: 且稷寬弛無防，僚吏頗侵漁之。
units.en: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often preyed on the province.
units.literal: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often encroached and fleeced.

units.zh: 初去吳興郡，以僕射徵，道由吳鄉，候稷者滿水陸。
units.en: When he first left Wuxing and was summoned as vice director, his route passed Wu country; those waiting for Ji filled land and water.
units.literal: When he first left Wuxing commandery and was summoned as Vice Director, his route passed his Wu homeland; those waiting to see Ji filled the waterways and roads.

units.zh: 稷單裝徑還京師，人莫之識，其率素如此。
units.en: Ji returned to the capital alone with plain baggage; no one knew him—such was his austerity.
units.literal: Ji returned to the capital alone with simple baggage; no one recognized him—such was his plain simplicity.

units.zh: 稷長女楚瑗，適會稽孔氏，無子歸宗。
units.en: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married the Kong clan of Kuaiji; childless, she returned to her clan.
units.literal: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married into the Kong clan of Kuaiji; having no son, she returned to her clan.

units.zh: 至稷見害，女以身蔽刃，先父卒。
units.en: When Ji was killed, his daughter shielded him with her body and died before her father.
units.literal: When Ji was killed, his daughter used her body to shield the blade and died before her father.

units.zh: 稷子嵊，別有傳。
units.en: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.
units.literal: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.

units.zh: 卷字令遠，稷從兄也。
units.en: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.
units.literal: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.

units.zh: 六世祖猛，秦苻堅丞相，家於華山之鄜城。
units.en: His sixth-generation ancestor Meng had been chancellor under Fu Jian of Former Qin; the family settled at Fucheng in Huashan.
units.literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Meng was chancellor under Fu Jian of Former Qin; the family settled at Fucheng in Huashan.

units.zh: 建武二年，魏主托跋宏寇赭陽，景宗爲偏將，每衝堅陷陣，輒有斬獲，以勳除遊擊將軍。
units.en: In Jianwu year two Tuoba Hong of Wei raided Zheyang; Jingzong was a flank commander, broke the line each time he charged, and was made Guerrilla General for merit.
units.literal: In the second year of Jianwu, Wei ruler Tuoba Hong raided Zheyang; Jingzong was a supporting general and each charge broke the enemy line, with beheadings each time; by merit he was made Guerrilla General.

units.zh: 魏主率衆大至，顯達宵奔，景宗導入山道，故顯達父子獲全。
units.en: The Wei ruler came in force; Xianda fled by night, and Jingzong led him through the mountains, so Xianda and his son escaped whole.
units.literal: The Wei ruler led a great army up; Xianda fled by night, and Jingzong guided him into mountain paths—therefore Xianda and his son were wholly saved.

units.zh: 姚興，字子略，萇之長子也。
units.en: Yao Xing, courtesy Zilüe, was the firstborn of Yao Chang.
units.literal: Yao Xing, style name Zilüe, was Yao Chang's eldest son.

units.zh: 萇之在馬牧，興自長安冒難奔萇，萇立為皇太子。
units.en: While Yao Chang was at the horse pastures, Yao Xing slipped out of Chang'an through danger to join him and was named heir.
units.literal: When Chang was at the horse pastures, Xing braved peril from Chang'an and fled to Chang; Chang established him as crown prince.

units.zh: 緯曰：「先帝登遐，人情擾懼，今不因思奮之力，梟殄逆豎，大事去矣。
units.en: Yin Wei answered, "The late emperor has just died and morale wavers; if we do not strike now and crush Fu Deng, all is lost.
units.literal: Wei said: "The late emperor has ascended far; human hearts are disturbed and fearful; now if we do not rely on the power of thinking of him and striving, beheading and destroying the rebellious stripling, the great affair is lost.

units.zh: 萇出征討，常留統後事。
units.en: Yao Chang habitually left him in charge of the rear whenever he marched.
units.literal: Whenever Chang went out on campaign, he regularly left him behind to oversee rear affairs.

units.zh: 萇死，興秘不發喪，以其叔父緒鎮安定，碩德鎮陰密，弟崇守長安。
units.en: Yao Xing hid his father's death, posting Yao Xu at Anding, Yao Shuode at Yinmi, and his brother Yao Chong in Chang'an.
units.literal: When Chang died, Xing kept it secret and did not announce mourning; he had his uncle Xu garrison Anding, Shuo De garrison Yinmi, and his younger brother Chong defend Chang'an.

units.zh: 興班告境內及在朝文武，立名不得犯叔父緒及碩德之名，以彰殊禮。
units.en: He forbade personal names that clashed with his uncles Yao Xu and Yao Shuode.
units.literal: Xing issued a proclamation to the borders and to civil and military officials at court that established names must not offend against the names of his uncles Xu and Shuo De, thereby displaying special courtesy.

units.zh: 九月丁未，以輔國將軍裴叔業為兖州刺史，征虜長史張沖為豫州刺史。
units.en: Ninth month, day dingwei: Pei Shuye, assists-the-state general, took Yanzhou; Zhang Chong, chief administrator on the campaign-against-barbarians staff, took Yuzhou.
units.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: Assists-the-State General Pei Shuye was made Inspector of Yanzhou; Chief Administrator of the Campaign-against-Barbarians staff Zhang Chong was made Inspector of Yuzhou.

units.zh: 昌義之
units.en: Chang Yizhi
units.literal: Chang Yizhi

units.zh: 梁天監中，左右驍騎領朱衣直閤，並給儀從，北徐州刺史
units.en: Under Liang's Tianjian reign, the left and right valiant cavalry led the vermilion-robed direct attendants and were both granted ceremonial escorts. The North Xuzhou inspector
units.literal: In Liang's Tianjian era, the Left and Right Valiant Cavalry led the Vermilion-Robed Direct Attendants and were both given ceremonial escorts. The North Xuzhou Inspector

units.zh: 首為此職。
units.en: was the first to hold this office.
units.literal: was the first to hold this office.
